description: This Swift file defines two SwiftUI components, PrimaryButton and SubtleButton, which are customizable button views used within an iOS user interfaces. The components utilize theme styling from AppTheme and support accessibility features.

classes.name: PrimaryButton
classes.description: A customizable primary styled button with loading indicator support.

classes.name: SubtleButton
classes.description: A subtler styled button suitable for less prominent actions.

methods.name: PrimaryButton
methods.description: Initializer for the primary button, takes a title, loading state, and action.

methods.name: SubtleButton
methods.description: Initializer for the subtle button, takes a title and action.
